text: The sidebar repair removes the automatic checkbox listener and its handler. At the fixed accepted revision, connectedCallback only resolves refcontrol, while the class comment still says checkbox wiring occurs automatically through CheckboxChange. Explicit command/click callers now provide the inspected state path. Read the implementation and callers before using this old comment as an API contract; no general documentation or DOM rule is inferred.
title: Modebox documentation still promises removed automatic checkbox wiring
